hatnet.source: User-supplied literature score; not locally reproduced

crossing_definition: First crossing of the piecewise-linear Set11 mean PInv curve

synthesis.alignment_definition: cos(u_j, r_j), r_j=(I-P_A)a_j; not raw effective-row cosine

definitions.metric: Mean of per-image unclipped PSNR (dB); equal image weights
definitions.x_axis: Nominal sampling rate (%): M / floor(0.01*H*W). Integer final budgets map to 1%.
definitions.interpolation: Linear interpolation per image on union of archived normalized measurement knots; no smoothing
definitions.terminal_markers: Final 32-chain posterior means; DiffPIR for Ours/Fixed, DDRM for AdaSense*
definitions.baseline: AdaSense* is the project variance-only baseline, with physical propagation/uint8 realization
definitions.fixed: Fixed Walsh also uses physical propagation and quantization; learned baseline has ideal measurements
definitions.attribution: Ours-versus-AdaSense gap is a method comparison, not a controlled bias-only ablation
definitions.std: Sample standard deviation, ddof=1, of the same 32 O draws used for synthesis
